Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens, Bd. II. Erlangen/Leipzig: Fleischer. Wordlist "Miranha Carapana-Tapuya", pp. 277-279.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing stated. The list (c. 200 Latin-glossed items plus one sentence, elicited by Martius from chief João Manoel on the upper Yupurá, footnote p. 277) prints acute accents on most words (e.g. gakaikaná, nóhwi, göhóckö, ganoagá, gamaámi, retóbbi, máhwarĩ); accent position is variable (penultimate and final both frequent). The acute is explained only in the Tupi-dictionary orthographic note, vol. II p. 29: the accent 'dient, den Vocal zu schärfen oder die Sylbe zu betonen', with no statement that it applies to the Miranha lists.
